name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A rounded upload panel with a faint grid, a heading and a small tile with an upload arrow. Hovering nudges the tile and draws a dashed outline, and a chosen file becomes a details row.
use: A form needs a forgiving single-file drop target that also works by click.
avoid: It accepts one file at a time, and the list is local only, with no progress or remove control.
a11y: The hidden input has no label and the dropzone has no visible focus ring; a chosen file is not announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded upload panel with a faint square grid behind the content, a white 'Upload file' heading and a grey instruction line. Below sits a small pale square with an upload arrow; once a file is added it becomes a wide dark row.
behaves: Hovering the pale square nudges it up and right while a dashed cyan outline appears. Choosing a file swaps the square for a full-width row showing the filename, size, type and modified date.
customise: Only an onChange callback is exposed. All copy, the grid, the hover nudge and the file-row layout are written into the file.
weight: light: A dropzone, one animated tile and a small static grid of divs.
demo: Heading 'Upload file', a drag-or-click instruction, and a chosen cover-1.png of 0.84 MB.
issues: The file row has no remove, progress or error state once a file is chosen.
polishWhy: Tidy dropzone and clear file row; the uploaded state has no remove or progress feedback.
